payload.title: Calculating Global Coherence
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of the Pyleoclim library to calculate global coherence between insolation and oxygen isotope records. It involves defining a function to handle correlations in records with large hiatuses, using the Climlab library to define insolation curves, and calculating correlations to identify the most correlated latitude. The notebook then computes global coherence between insolation at this latitude and each record, and visualizes the results.
